AL.title: Election Protection Volunteer
AL.description: Help make sure every eligible voter in Alabama can cast their ballot. Sign up to volunteer with Election Protection and we'll connect you with training and opportunities near you.

AZ.title: Poll Monitor
AZ.description: Spend a shift at a polling place helping voters and watching for problems that could keep people from casting their ballot. Training is available live online, in person, or on demand.

CA.title: Poll Monitor
CA.description: Spend a shift at a polling place helping voters and watching for problems that could keep people from casting their ballot. Training is live online, with several sessions to choose from.

FL.title: Poll Monitor
FL.description: Help voters at the polls and watch for voter suppression or other problems that could keep people from casting their ballot. Open to anyone; training is live online, with many sessions to choose from.

FL.title: Legal Observer
FL.description: Observe early voting sites and help flag problems so they can be addressed quickly. Open to clergy, organizers and law students; training is live online.

FL.title: Poll Worker
FL.description: Work at a polling place in your county, helping run a fair and safe election for your neighbors. Poll workers are hired and trained by local election officials.

FL.title: Canvassing Board Monitor
FL.description: Observe county canvassing board meetings where ballots are reviewed and votes are counted, and report anything that looks wrong. Open to anyone.

FL.title: Voting Rights Legal Monitor
FL.description: Lawyers can serve as legal monitors at the polls on Election Day, helping resolve problems on the spot so eligible voters can cast their ballot.

FL.title: Canvassing Board Legal Monitor
FL.description: Lawyers can monitor county canvassing board proceedings as ballots are reviewed and counted, helping make sure every valid vote is counted.

GA.title: Poll Monitor
GA.description: Spend a shift at a polling place helping voters and watching for problems that could keep people from casting their ballot. Training is live online.

GA.title: Field Captain
GA.description: Support a team of poll monitors in your area, helping them get where they need to be and making sure problems at the polls get reported. Training is live online.

IN.title: Roving Poll Monitor
IN.description: Travel between several polling places, checking in on how voting is going and reporting problems so they can be fixed quickly. Training is available live online or in person, with several sessions to choose from.
